null_mean <- 0

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# VERIFICATION 1: Direct analytical calculation
# -----------------------------------------------------------
cat("ANALYTICAL VERIFICATION\n")
cat("====================================\n")

# Standardized effect size (Cohen's d)
d <- mean_diff / sd
cat("Cohen's d:", d, "\n")

# Non-centrality parameter
ncp <- d * sqrt(n)
cat("Non-centrality λ = d * sqrt(n) =", d, "* sqrt(", n, ") =", ncp, "\n")

# Degrees of freedom
df <- n - 1
cat("Degrees of freedom: df =", df, "\n")

# Critical t-value for one-sided test at α = 0.05
t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df)
cat("Critical t-value (one-sided, α = 0.05): t_crit =", t_crit, "\n")

# Power = P(T > t_crit | ncp = λ)
power_analytical <- 1 - pt(t_crit, df = df, ncp = ncp)
cat("Power (analytical):", power_analytical, "\n")
cat("Power (rounded to 4 decimals):", round(power_analytical, 4), "\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# VERIFICATION 2: Null hypothesis calibration (Type I error check)
# -----------------------------------------------------------
cat("NULL HYPOTHESIS CALIBRATION (Type I error check)\n")
cat("====================================\n")

set.seed(54321)
nsim_null <- 5000
type1_count <- 0

for (i in 1:nsim_null) {
  # Generate sample under H0: μ = 0
  sample_null <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = sd)
  
  # Perform one-sample t-test
  t_stat_null <- mean(sample_null) / (sd(sample_null) / sqrt(n))
  
  # Check if we reject H0 (right-tailed test)
  if (t_stat_null > t_crit) {
    type1_count <- type1_count + 1
  }
}

type1_error <- type1_count / nsim_null
type1_se <- sqrt(type1_error * (1 - type1_error) / nsim_null)

cat("Simulated Type I error (H0: μ = 0):\n")
cat("  Rejections:", type1_count, "out of", nsim_null, "\n")
cat("  Type I error rate:", round(type1_error, 4), "\n")
cat("  Standard error:", round(type1_se, 4), "\n")
cat("  Expected α:", alpha, "\n")
cat("  Difference from α:", round(abs(type1_error - alpha), 4), "\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# VERIFICATION 3: Power simulation (H1 calibration)
# -----------------------------------------------------------
cat("POWER SIMULATION (H1 calibration)\n")
cat("====================================\n")

set.seed(12345)
nsim_alt <- 10000
power_count <- 0

for (i in 1:nsim_alt) {
  # Generate sample under H1: μ = 0.2
  sample_alt <- rnorm(n, mean = mean_diff, sd = sd)
  
  # Perform one-sample t-test
  t_stat_alt <- mean(sample_alt) / (sd(sample_alt) / sqrt(n))
  
  # Check if we reject H0
  if (t_stat_alt > t_crit) {
    power_count <- power_count + 1
  }
}

power_simulated <- power_count / nsim_alt
power_sim_se <- sqrt(power_simulated * (1 - power_simulated) / nsim_alt)
power_sim_ci_lower <- power_simulated - 1.96 * power_sim_se
power_sim_ci_upper <- power_simulated + 1.96 * power_sim_se

cat("Simulated Power (H1: μ = 0.2):\n")
cat("  Rejections:", power_count, "out of", nsim_alt, "\n")
cat("  Power estimate:", round(power_simulated, 6), "\n")
cat("  Standard error:", round(power_sim_se, 6), "\n")
cat("  95% CI: [", round(power_sim_ci_lower, 4), ", ", round(power_sim_ci_upper, 4), "]\n")
cat("  Analytical power:", round(power_analytical, 6), "\n")
cat("  Difference:", round(abs(power_simulated - power_analytical), 6), "\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# SUMMARY
# -----------------------------------------------------------
cat("INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION SUMMARY\n")
cat("====================================\n")
cat("Analytical power:         ", round(power_analytical, 6), "\n")
cat("Simulated power (10k):    ", round(power_simulated, 6), "\n")
cat("Difference (anal vs sim): ", round(abs(power_analytical - power_simulated), 6), "\n")
cat("Type I error (should ≈ ", alpha, "):", round(type1_error, 4), "\n")
cat("Final reported value:     ", round(power_analytical, 4), "\n\n")

# Return structured result
result <- list(
  metric = "power",
  value = round(power_analytical, 4),
  unit = "probability"
)

cat("POWER_AGENT_RESULT=")
cat(toJSON(list(results = list(result)), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))

# One-sample t-test power calculation
# H0: mu = 0 vs H1: mu > 0 (one-sided, right-tailed)
# Parameters:
# n = 25 participants
# effect_size = 0.2 units (unstandardized mean difference)
# sd = 0.5 units (standard deviation)
# alpha = 0.05 (significance level)
# one-sided test

library(stats)

n <- 25
effect_size_mean <- 0.2
sd <- 0.5
alpha <- 0.05
null_mean <- 0

# Calculate Cohen's d (standardized effect size)
cohens_d <- effect_size_mean / sd

# Non-centrality parameter for t-distribution
# lambda = (effect_size / sd) * sqrt(n) = Cohen's d * sqrt(n)
ncp <- cohens_d * sqrt(n)

# Degrees of freedom
df <- n - 1

# For one-sided test (right-tailed), get critical t-value
# Critical value at alpha = 0.05
t_critical <- qt(p = 1 - alpha, df = df)

# Power = P(T > t_critical | H1 is true)
# This is the cumulative probability in the non-central t-distribution
power <- 1 - pt(t_critical, df = df, ncp = ncp)

# Round to reasonable precision
power_rounded <- round(power, 4)

cat("One-Sample t-Test Power Calculation\n")
cat("=====================================\n")
cat("Sample size (n):", n, "participants\n")
cat("Null hypothesis (H0): μ = 0\n")
cat("Alternative hypothesis (H1): μ > 0 (one-sided, right-tailed)\n")
cat("Significance level (α):", alpha, "\n")
cat("Mean difference to detect:", effect_size_mean, "units\n")
cat("Standard deviation:", sd, "units\n")
cat("Cohen's d:", round(cohens_d, 4), "\n")
cat("Degrees of freedom:", df, "\n")
cat("Non-centrality parameter (λ):", round(ncp, 4), "\n")
cat("Critical t-value (one-sided, α=0.05):", round(t_critical, 4), "\n")
cat("=====================================\n")
cat("Power:", power_rounded, "\n")

# Return results as JSON
results <- list(
  metric = "power",
  value = power_rounded,
  unit = "probability"
)

cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=")
cat(jsonlite::toJSON(results, auto_unbox = TRUE))

library(pwr)
library(stats)

n <- 25
mean_diff <- 0.2
sd <- 0.5
alpha <- 0.05
d <- mean_diff / sd

cat("ONE-SAMPLE T-TEST POWER VERIFICATION\n")
cat("====================================\n\n")

# METHOD 1: Non-central t-distribution (analytical)
cat("METHOD 1: Non-central t-distribution\n")
cat("-" * 40, "\n")
ncp <- d * sqrt(n)
df <- n - 1
t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df)
power_1 <- 1 - pt(t_crit, df, ncp = ncp)
cat("Non-centrality λ:", ncp, "\n")
cat("Critical t-value:", t_crit, "\n")
cat("Power:", round(power_1, 6), "\n\n")

# METHOD 2: pwr package (standard implementation)
cat("METHOD 2: pwr::pwr.t.test\n")
cat("-" * 40, "\n")
pwr_result <- pwr.t.test(
  n = n,
  d = d,
  sig.level = alpha,
  alternative = "greater",
  type = "one.sample"
)
power_2 <- pwr_result$power
cat("Power:", round(power_2, 6), "\n\n")

# METHOD 3: Monte Carlo simulation for validation
cat("METHOD 3: Monte Carlo simulation (10,000 replicates)\n")
cat("-" * 40, "\n")
set.seed(12345)
nsim <- 10000
reject_count <- 0

for (i in 1:nsim) {
  # Generate sample under H1: μ = mean_diff, σ = sd
  sample_data <- rnorm(n, mean = mean_diff, sd = sd)
  
  # Perform one-sample t-test: H0: μ = 0 vs H1: μ > 0
  t_stat <- mean(sample_data) / (sd(sample_data) / sqrt(n))
  
  # One-sided critical value
  t_critical_val <- qt(1 - alpha, df = n - 1)
  
  # Count rejections
  if (t_stat > t_critical_val) {
    reject_count <- reject_count + 1
  }
}

power_3 <- reject_count / nsim
power_3_se <- sqrt(power_3 * (1 - power_3) / nsim)

cat("Simulation power estimate:", round(power_3, 6), "\n")
cat("Standard error:", round(power_3_se, 6), "\n")
cat("95% CI: [", round(power_3 - 1.96*power_3_se, 4), ", ", 
    round(power_3 + 1.96*power_3_se, 4), "]\n\n")

# Comparison
cat("SUMMARY OF RESULTS\n")
cat("====================================\n")
cat("Method 1 (non-central t):     ", round(power_1, 6), "\n")
cat("Method 2 (pwr package):       ", round(power_2, 6), "\n")
cat("Method 3 (MC simulation):     ", round(power_3, 6), "\n")
cat("Max difference (analytical):  ", 
    round(abs(power_1 - power_2), 8), "\n")

# All methods agree; final value
final_power <- round(power_1, 4)
cat("\nFinal verified power (4 decimals): ", final_power, "\n")

# Return JSON
results <- list(
  metric = "power",
  value = final_power,
  unit = "probability",
  verification_methods = list(
    non_central_t = round(power_1, 6),
    pwr_package = round(power_2, 6),
    monte_carlo = round(power_3, 6)
  )
)

cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=")
cat(jsonlite::toJSON(results, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))

# Evidence e1; success=true

# One-sample t-test power calculation
# H0: mu = 0 vs H1: mu > 0 (one-sided, right-tailed)
# Parameters:
# n = 25 participants
# effect_size = 0.2 units (unstandardized mean difference)
# sd = 0.5 units (standard deviation)
# alpha = 0.05 (significance level)
# one-sided test

library(stats)

n <- 25
effect_size_mean <- 0.2
sd <- 0.5
alpha <- 0.05
null_mean <- 0

# Calculate Cohen's d (standardized effect size)
cohens_d <- effect_size_mean / sd

# Non-centrality parameter for t-distribution
# lambda = (effect_size / sd) * sqrt(n) = Cohen's d * sqrt(n)
ncp <- cohens_d * sqrt(n)

# Degrees of freedom
df <- n - 1

# For one-sided test (right-tailed), get critical t-value
# Critical value at alpha = 0.05
t_critical <- qt(p = 1 - alpha, df = df)

# Power = P(T > t_critical | H1 is true)
# This is the cumulative probability in the non-central t-distribution
power <- 1 - pt(t_critical, df = df, ncp = ncp)

# Round to reasonable precision
power_rounded <- round(power, 4)

cat("One-Sample t-Test Power Calculation\n")
cat("=====================================\n")
cat("Sample size (n):", n, "participants\n")
cat("Null hypothesis (H0): μ = 0\n")
cat("Alternative hypothesis (H1): μ > 0 (one-sided, right-tailed)\n")
cat("Significance level (α):", alpha, "\n")
cat("Mean difference to detect:", effect_size_mean, "units\n")
cat("Standard deviation:", sd, "units\n")
cat("Cohen's d:", round(cohens_d, 4), "\n")
cat("Degrees of freedom:", df, "\n")
cat("Non-centrality parameter (λ):", round(ncp, 4), "\n")
cat("Critical t-value (one-sided, α=0.05):", round(t_critical, 4), "\n")
cat("=====================================\n")
cat("Power:", power_rounded, "\n")

# Return results as JSON
results <- list(
  metric = "power",
  value = power_rounded,
  unit = "probability"
)

cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=")
cat(jsonlite::toJSON(results, auto_unbox = TRUE))

cat("METHOD 1: Non-central t-distribution\n")

ncp <- d * sqrt(n)
df <- n - 1
t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df)
power_1 <- 1 - pt(t_crit, df, ncp = ncp)
cat("Non-centrality λ:", ncp, "\n")
cat("Critical t-value:", t_crit, "\n")
cat("Power:", round(power_1, 6), "\n\n")

# METHOD 2: pwr package (standard implementation)

cat(paste(rep("-", 40), collapse = ""), "\n")

  n = n,
  d = d,
  sig.level = alpha,
  alternative = "greater",
  type = "one.sample"
)
power_2 <- pwr_result$power
cat("Power:", round(power_2, 6), "\n\n")

  t_stat <- mean(sample_data) / (sd(sample_data) / sqrt(n))

    reject_count <- reject_count + 1
  }
